claims.text: The rear suspension setting table lists the 3rd notch for the unladen / one-up / rider-only condition, with the setting based on rider weight.
The manual says the best spring preload setting is the one matched to the weight of the rider and any luggage and passenger.

The adjuster is a 6-step adjuster. The procedure text on the same topic also says it is kept at the first notch position, and the manual does not reconcile this with the 3rd notch in the rider-only table row.
The manual does not explain why these two statements differ, so for solo riding the table's 3rd notch is the specific setting it gives.
In the rear-suspension setting table, tyre pressure is printed as one merged cell reading 32 psi that spans Front and Rear for both the rider-only and the laden rows.
